_doc: Battle art sources. src = the generated still (facing right) that becomes frame 0; canvas = the animation canvas it is padded onto (feet `foot` px above the bottom, body shifted `dx` px from centre); prompts drive animate_image_pixminimax; strike = attack frame where the blow lands or the shot leaves; shot = where a projectile starts, in canvas px. Paths are relative to games/inkheroes/dev/. face = the centre of the unit's face in its idle frame (canvas px), for the 24 x 24 turn-order portrait. walkLock = how far each walk frame is shifted sideways so the body holds still (a gallop the generator let surge back and forth).

spearman.name: Hoplite
spearman.subject: an ancient greek hoplite with bronze helmet, round bronze shield and spear
spearman.attack: spear thrust attack: draws the spear back, lunges forward thrusting the spear hard to the right, then recovers to the starting pose; feet stay in place
